source: The Guardian live second round results
notes: Count under way; no winner called. Flávio's lead has narrowed from 278,020 (34.1% counted) to 157,724 (42.8%) and now 12,941 (46.5%). Extension: STF says Zanin ruled in Reclamação 101673, filed by Lula's coalition (Brasil Pronto Pra Mais) against Salvador, Feira de Santana and Lauro de Freitas cutting public transport, citing the STF's ADPF 1013 duty to provide free election-day transit; he granted it nationally because both campaigns reported voter-transport problems. He later clarified it applied only where machines were still open at 17h (TSE note, Valor). TSE president Nunes Marques told TREs at 17h49 to keep open sections running to 19h, with no reopening (O Globo). Lula's coalition cited 9 states; Flávio's campaign asked for 2 more hours in rain-hit towns in MG, RS, PR, SP and SC (G1). Bolsonaro allies called it an intervention that 'only helps whoever is losing' (Guardian); no published vote-impact analysis found. NSC Total: there is not yet a tally of how many machines were still open when the order came; TRE-SC's president said he learned of it from the press and his TRE closed at 17h.
